  039-repo-architecture-map:
    source_sha256: 6945ca030cfa4d65f3895c72f89bac8b7d8203eac83215b856ac2f590f82a0ae
    instructions:
      english: "You are given a small Python service repository at `$WORKSPACE/in/repo`.\n\nCreate exactly these deliverables:\n\
        \n1. `$WORKSPACE/out/module_map.json`\n   - JSON object with keys: `modules`, `entry_points`, `dependency_edges`,\
        \ `key_functions`.\n   - `modules` must be an array of module objects with at least `name`, `path`, and `purpose`.\n\
        \   - `entry_points` must list executable/API entry points using canonical `module:function` identifiers where applicable,\
        \ including `minisvc.cli:main` and `minisvc.api.routes:register_routes`.\n   - `dependency_edges` must contain directed\
        \ edges as objects with `from`, `to`, and `type`; `type` should be one of `imports`, `calls`, `instantiates`, `reads_config`,\
        \ or `persists_to`.\n   - `key_functions` must describe important functions and methods.\n   - Include a `runtime_flows`\
        \ array describing at least the CLI startup flow and the HTTP create-order flow as ordered steps.\n2. `$WORKSPACE/out/architecture.md`\n\
        \   - Markdown architecture summary for a new engineer.\n   - Include modules, entry points, data flow, storage, and\
        \ risks/extension points.\n   - Call out any important runtime flow and avoid treating package marker files as business\
        \ logic modules.\n3. `$WORKSPACE/out/doc_code_discrepancies.csv`\n   - CSV with header `claim,doc_source,code_evidence,assessment,risk`.\n\
        \   - Compare README/design notes against the actual implementation.\n   - At minimum, cover readonly enforcement,\
        \ retry behavior, and audit persistence if they differ from code.\n   - `assessment` should be one of `confirmed`,\
        \ `contradicted`, or `unsupported`.\n4. `$WORKSPACE/out/risk_register.csv`\n   - CSV with header `risk_id,area,evidence,impact,mitigation,owner_hint`.\n\
        \   - Cover at least storage/data durability, audit behavior, configuration/runtime environment, and API input validation.\n\
        \   - Each row must cite concrete code evidence such as a module, function, or filename.\n5. `$WORKSPACE/out/onboarding_plan.md`\n\
        \   - A concise onboarding plan for a new engineer.\n   - Include a recommended read order, local run/test commands,\
        \ first debugging breakpoint or trace point, and two safe first changes.\n   - The plan must distinguish active runtime\
        \ code from package marker/dead-simple files.\n\nDo not modify anything under `$WORKSPACE/in/repo`. Do not use internet\
        \ access. Use only the files in the fixture repository.\n"
      hindi: "आपको `$WORKSPACE/in/repo` में एक छोटा Python service repository दिया गया है।\n\nठीक ये deliverables बनाएँ:\n\
        \n1. `$WORKSPACE/out/module_map.json`\n   - `modules`, `entry_points`, `dependency_edges`, `key_functions` keys वाला\
        \ JSON object बनाएँ।\n   - `modules` में कम-से-कम `name`, `path`, `purpose` वाले module objects की array हो।\n   -\
        \ `entry_points` में executable/API entry points को जहाँ लागू हो canonical `module:function` identifiers के रूप में\
        \ रखें; इसमें `minisvc.cli:main` और `minisvc.api.routes:register_routes` अवश्य हों।\n   - `dependency_edges` में `from`,\
        \ `to`, `type` वाले directed edge objects हों; `type` केवल `imports`, `calls`, `instantiates`, `reads_config`, या\
        \ `persists_to` में से हो।\n   - `key_functions` महत्वपूर्ण functions और methods का वर्णन करे।\n   - कम-से-कम CLI\
        \ startup flow और HTTP create-order flow को ordered steps के रूप में बताने वाली `runtime_flows` array शामिल करें।\n\
        2. `$WORKSPACE/out/architecture.md`\n   - नए engineer के लिए Markdown architecture summary लिखें।\n   - modules, entry\
        \ points, data flow, storage और risks/extension points शामिल करें।\n   - महत्वपूर्ण runtime flow को स्पष्ट करें और\
        \ package marker files को business-logic modules न मानें।\n3. `$WORKSPACE/out/doc_code_discrepancies.csv`\n   - header\
        \ `claim,doc_source,code_evidence,assessment,risk` रखें।\n   - README/design notes की actual implementation से तुलना\
        \ करें।\n   - कम-से-कम readonly enforcement, retry behavior और audit persistence को cover करें यदि वे code से अलग\
        \ हैं।\n   - `assessment` केवल `confirmed`, `contradicted`, या `unsupported` हो।\n4. `$WORKSPACE/out/risk_register.csv`\n\
        \   - header `risk_id,area,evidence,impact,mitigation,owner_hint` रखें।\n   - storage/data durability, audit behavior,\
        \ configuration/runtime environment और API input validation को cover करें।\n   - हर row में module, function या filename\
        \ जैसे concrete code evidence दें।\n5. `$WORKSPACE/out/onboarding_plan.md`\n   - नए engineer के लिए संक्षिप्त onboarding\
        \ plan लिखें।\n   - recommended read order, local run/test commands, पहला debugging breakpoint/trace point और दो safe\
        \ first changes शामिल करें।\n   - active runtime code को package marker/dead-simple files से अलग दिखाएँ।\n\n`$WORKSPACE/in/repo`\
        \ के अंदर कुछ भी modify न करें। Internet access न लें। केवल fixture repository की files उपयोग करें।"
      hinglish: "Aapko `$WORKSPACE/in/repo` mein ek chhota Python service repository diya gaya hai.\n\nExactly ye deliverables\
        \ banao:\n\n1. `$WORKSPACE/out/module_map.json`\n   - `modules`, `entry_points`, `dependency_edges`, `key_functions`\
        \ keys wala JSON object.\n   - `modules` mein kam-se-kam `name`, `path`, `purpose` wale module objects ki array ho.\n\
        \   - `entry_points` mein executable/API entry points ko applicable jagah canonical `module:function` identifiers\
        \ ke roop mein rakho; `minisvc.cli:main` aur `minisvc.api.routes:register_routes` zaroor include karo.\n   - `dependency_edges`\
        \ directed objects hon jinke fields `from`, `to`, `type` hain; `type` sirf `imports`, `calls`, `instantiates`, `reads_config`,\
        \ ya `persists_to` ho.\n   - `key_functions` important functions aur methods describe kare.\n   - `runtime_flows`\
        \ array mein kam-se-kam CLI startup flow aur HTTP create-order flow ko ordered steps mein describe karo.\n2. `$WORKSPACE/out/architecture.md`\n\
        \   - New engineer ke liye Markdown architecture summary likho.\n   - modules, entry points, data flow, storage aur\
        \ risks/extension points cover karo.\n   - important runtime flow call out karo aur package marker files ko business-logic\
        \ modules mat samjho.\n3. `$WORKSPACE/out/doc_code_discrepancies.csv`\n   - header `claim,doc_source,code_evidence,assessment,risk`\
        \ rakho.\n   - README/design notes ko actual implementation se compare karo.\n   - readonly enforcement, retry behavior\
        \ aur audit persistence ko kam-se-kam cover karo jab code se difference ho.\n   - `assessment` sirf `confirmed`, `contradicted`,\
        \ ya `unsupported` ho.\n4. `$WORKSPACE/out/risk_register.csv`\n   - header `risk_id,area,evidence,impact,mitigation,owner_hint`\
        \ rakho.\n   - storage/data durability, audit behavior, configuration/runtime environment aur API input validation\
        \ cover karo.\n   - har row mein module, function ya filename jaisa concrete code evidence do.\n5. `$WORKSPACE/out/onboarding_plan.md`\n\
        \   - New engineer ke liye concise onboarding plan likho.\n   - recommended read order, local run/test commands, first\
        \ debugging breakpoint/trace point aur do safe first changes include karo.\n   - active runtime code ko package marker/dead-simple\
        \ files se clearly alag karo.\n\n`$WORKSPACE/in/repo` ke andar kuch modify mat karo. Internet use mat karo; sirf fixture\
        \ repository ki files use karo."
    review:
      english:
        status: canonical
        reviewer: null
      hindi:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
      hinglish:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
  040-test-coverage-fill:
    source_sha256: 8d8d7a5316d3e9e146cbf863cb2c5911dd1e50f366ec2e3bc2fbacbdfef89792
    instructions:
      english: 'The Python package in `$WORKSPACE/in/ordercalc` has incomplete tests.


        Your job:

        - Add or edit tests under `$WORKSPACE/in/ordercalc/tests/`.

        - Do not edit files under `$WORKSPACE/in/ordercalc/ordercalc/`.

        - Read `$WORKSPACE/in/ordercalc/pricing_rules.md` and turn the behavioral contract into tests.

        - Include boundary cases that would fail if discount order, free-shipping threshold, bulk aggregation, or rounding
        behavior were implemented incorrectly.

        - The evaluator will run mutation checks against intentionally broken pricing implementations; good tests should fail
        those mutants.

        - The final command `python -m pytest $WORKSPACE/in/ordercalc/tests` must pass.

        - Add `$WORKSPACE/in/ordercalc/tests/TEST_INTENT.md` explaining which pricing-rule risks your tests cover. It must
        mention discount order, free-shipping threshold, bulk aggregation, rounding, coupons, expedited shipping, and validation
        errors.


        Forbidden:

        - Do not hard-code private implementation text such as exact source line snippets.

        - Do not monkeypatch the functions under test to force success.

        - Do not skip or xfail the required behavior tests.

        '
      hindi: '`$WORKSPACE/in/ordercalc` Python package में incomplete tests हैं।


        आपका काम:

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/ordercalc/tests/` के अंदर tests जोड़ें या edit करें।

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/ordercalc/ordercalc/` के अंदर files edit न करें।

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/ordercalc/pricing_rules.md` पढ़कर behavioral contract को tests में बदलें।

        - ऐसे boundary cases शामिल करें जो discount order, free-shipping threshold, bulk aggregation या rounding गलत होने
        पर fail हों।

        - Evaluator जानबूझकर broken pricing implementations पर mutation checks चलाएगा; अच्छे tests उन mutants को fail करें।

        - अंतिम command `python -m pytest $WORKSPACE/in/ordercalc/tests` पास होना चाहिए।

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/ordercalc/tests/TEST_INTENT.md` लिखें और बताएं कि tests किन pricing-rule risks को cover करते हैं।
        इसमें discount order, free-shipping threshold, bulk aggregation, rounding, coupons, expedited shipping और validation
        errors का उल्लेख होना चाहिए।


        निषिद्ध:

        - private implementation text जैसे exact source line snippets hard-code न करें।

        - success force करने के लिए functions under test को monkeypatch न करें।

        - आवश्यक behavior tests को skip या xfail न करें।'
      hinglish: '`$WORKSPACE/in/ordercalc` Python package mein incomplete tests hain.


        Aapka kaam:

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/ordercalc/tests/` ke andar tests add ya edit karo.

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/ordercalc/ordercalc/` ke andar files edit mat karo.

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/ordercalc/pricing_rules.md` padho aur behavioral contract ko tests mein badlo.

        - Aise boundary cases zaroor do jo discount order, free-shipping threshold, bulk aggregation ya rounding galat hone
        par fail ho jayen.

        - Evaluator intentionally broken pricing implementations par mutation checks chalayega; strong tests un mutants ko
        fail karein.

        - Final command `python -m pytest $WORKSPACE/in/ordercalc/tests` pass hona chahiye.

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/ordercalc/tests/TEST_INTENT.md` likho aur batao tests kaunse pricing-rule risks cover karte hain.
        Ismein discount order, free-shipping threshold, bulk aggregation, rounding, coupons, expedited shipping aur validation
        errors mention hone chahiye.


        Forbidden:

        - private implementation text, jaise exact source line snippets, hard-code mat karo.

        - functions under test ko monkeypatch karke success force mat karo.

        - required behavior tests ko skip ya xfail mat karo.'
    review:
      english:
        status: canonical
        reviewer: null
      hindi:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
      hinglish:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
  042-api-schema-migration:
    source_sha256: 487e1a28e8a654eefed3c0103e7d51ff162aff99baef2ac7bcced7e633aeb13b
    instructions:
      english: 'The project in `$WORKSPACE/in/schema_migration` converts legacy order payloads to a new API shape. The schemas
        have changed and `client.py` is incomplete.


        Before editing, read `migration_notes.md`, `pii_policy.md`, and `sample_payloads.jsonl`; they define version-specific
        field mappings, PII exclusions, and dirty sample records.


        Your job:

        - Update `$WORKSPACE/in/schema_migration/client.py`.

        - Do not edit `old_schema.json`, `new_schema.json`, `migration_notes.md`, `pii_policy.md`, `sample_payloads.jsonl`,
        or files under `tests/`.

        - Make `python -m pytest $WORKSPACE/in/schema_migration/tests` pass.

        - Preserve backward compatibility with legacy payloads and produce the new schema fields exactly.

        - Support both legacy v1 payloads and already-v2 payloads.

        - Support legacy v1.1 and v1.2 payloads described in `migration_notes.md`, including nested `customer`, `lines`, `shipTo`,
        `order_ref`, and `unit_price_cents`.

        - Preserve unknown v2 metadata fields under metadata.unknownFields.

        - For legacy payloads, preserve unmapped extra fields under metadata.unknownFields, except obvious PII-like keys such
        as `ssn` or `credit_card`.

        - Default blank or null shipping methods to "standard".

        - Add error aggregation via convert_many(payloads), returning at least `(converted, errors)` without stopping on the
        first bad payload. Each error must include `index`, `path`, and `error`.

        - If warnings are generated, return them as a third item or include them in a compatible result object. Each warning
        must include `index`, `path`, and `warning`.

        - Write `$WORKSPACE/in/schema_migration/conversion_audit.json` when convert_many is called, summarizing converted_count,
        error_count, warning_count, pii_dropped_count, and unknown_fields_count.

        - Already-v2 payloads must be idempotent: do not drop metadata.unknownFields or rewrite valid line items.

        - Add CLI support so `python -m client input.jsonl output.json` reads JSONL payloads, writes the converted records
        as JSON, and writes the audit file next to `client.py`.

        - Hidden checks include multiple line items, alternate legacy shipping postal fields, and error records with useful
        paths such as `customer_id` or `items[0].qty`.


        Do not call external APIs. Do not replace the converter with hard-coded fixture-only output.

        '
      hindi: '`$WORKSPACE/in/schema_migration` project legacy order payloads को नए API shape में बदलता है और `client.py` अधूरी
        है।


        Edit से पहले `migration_notes.md`, `pii_policy.md`, और `sample_payloads.jsonl` पढ़ें; इनमें version-specific field
        mappings, PII exclusions और dirty sample records परिभाषित हैं।


        आपका काम:

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/schema_migration/client.py` update करें।

        - `old_schema.json`, `new_schema.json`, `migration_notes.md`, `pii_policy.md`, `sample_payloads.jsonl` या `tests/`
        के अंदर files edit न करें।

        - `python -m pytest $WORKSPACE/in/schema_migration/tests` पास कराएँ।

        - Legacy payloads के साथ backward compatibility रखें और नए schema fields बिल्कुल सही बनाएं।

        - Legacy v1 और पहले से v2 payloads दोनों support करें।

        - `migration_notes.md` में बताए legacy v1.1 और v1.2 support करें, जिनमें nested `customer`, `lines`, `shipTo`, `order_ref`,
        और `unit_price_cents` हैं।

        - Unknown v2 metadata fields को `metadata.unknownFields` के अंदर रखें।

        - Legacy payloads में unmapped extra fields `metadata.unknownFields` में रखें, लेकिन `ssn` या `credit_card` जैसे स्पष्ट
        PII keys छोड़ दें।

        - Blank या null shipping methods को `standard` default दें।

        - `convert_many(payloads)` के जरिए error aggregation जोड़ें: कम-से-कम `(converted, errors)` लौटाएँ और पहले bad payload
        पर रुकें नहीं। हर error में `index`, `path`, और `error` हों।

        - Warnings हों तो तीसरा item लौटाएँ या compatible result object में रखें; हर warning में `index`, `path`, और `warning`
        हों।

        - `convert_many` बुलाए जाने पर `$WORKSPACE/in/schema_migration/conversion_audit.json` लिखें, जिसमें converted_count,
        error_count, warning_count, pii_dropped_count और unknown_fields_count हों।

        - पहले से v2 payloads idempotent हों: `metadata.unknownFields` न हटाएँ और valid line items rewrite न करें।

        - CLI support जोड़ें ताकि `python -m client input.jsonl output.json` JSONL payloads पढ़े, converted records JSON में
        लिखे और audit file `client.py` के पास लिखे।

        - Hidden checks में multiple line items, alternate legacy shipping postal fields और useful paths जैसे `customer_id`
        या `items[0].qty` वाले errors होंगे।


        External APIs न बुलाएँ और converter को fixture-only hard-coded output से replace न करें।'
      hinglish: '`$WORKSPACE/in/schema_migration` project legacy order payloads ko naye API shape mein convert karta hai aur
        `client.py` incomplete hai.


        Edit se pehle `migration_notes.md`, `pii_policy.md`, aur `sample_payloads.jsonl` padho; ye version-specific mappings,
        PII exclusions aur dirty sample records define karte hain.


        Aapka kaam:

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/schema_migration/client.py` update karo.

        - `old_schema.json`, `new_schema.json`, `migration_notes.md`, `pii_policy.md`, `sample_payloads.jsonl`, ya `tests/`
        ke andar files edit mat karo.

        - `python -m pytest $WORKSPACE/in/schema_migration/tests` pass karao.

        - Legacy payloads ki backward compatibility rakho aur new schema fields exact banao.

        - Legacy v1 aur already-v2 payloads dono support karo.

        - `migration_notes.md` wale legacy v1.1 aur v1.2 support karo, including nested `customer`, `lines`, `shipTo`, `order_ref`,
        aur `unit_price_cents`.

        - Unknown v2 metadata fields ko `metadata.unknownFields` mein preserve karo.

        - Legacy payloads ke unmapped extra fields `metadata.unknownFields` mein rakho, lekin `ssn` ya `credit_card` jaise
        obvious PII keys drop karo.

        - Blank ya null shipping methods ka default `standard` rakho.

        - `convert_many(payloads)` se error aggregation add karo: kam-se-kam `(converted, errors)` return ho aur first bad
        payload par stop na ho. Har error mein `index`, `path`, aur `error` ho.

        - Warnings generate hon to third item return karo ya compatible result object mein include karo; har warning mein
        `index`, `path`, aur `warning` ho.

        - `convert_many` call hone par `$WORKSPACE/in/schema_migration/conversion_audit.json` likho, with converted_count,
        error_count, warning_count, pii_dropped_count, unknown_fields_count.

        - Already-v2 payloads idempotent hon: `metadata.unknownFields` drop na ho aur valid line items rewrite na hon.

        - CLI support add karo taaki `python -m client input.jsonl output.json` JSONL payloads padhe, converted records JSON
        mein likhe aur audit file `client.py` ke paas likhe.

        - Hidden checks multiple line items, alternate legacy shipping postal fields aur `customer_id` ya `items[0].qty` jaise
        useful error paths test karenge.


        External APIs mat bulao. Converter ko fixture-only hard-coded output se replace mat karo.'
    review:
      english:
        status: canonical
        reviewer: null
      hindi:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
      hinglish:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
  043-db-migration-safety:
    source_sha256: 3a1b8a02eacd81b4f5e0ac8e578cadf1d8219cfe80cc85b3e5c14b88765b6952
    instructions:
      english: 'The SQLite migration draft at `$WORKSPACE/in/db/migration.sql` is unsafe. It loses data while trying to add
        account status and email constraints.


        Read `$WORKSPACE/in/db/migration_policy.md` before editing. It defines the required dirty-data cleanup, dependent
        order preservation, transaction, idempotency, and rollback expectations.


        Your job:

        - Edit only `$WORKSPACE/in/db/migration.sql`.

        - Do not edit `$WORKSPACE/in/db/schema.sql` or `$WORKSPACE/in/db/migration_policy.md`.

        - Preserve all existing users from `$WORKSPACE/in/db/schema.sql`.

        - Preserve all existing orders and their `user_id` references.

        - Add a non-null `status` column with default `active`.

        - Enforce unique, non-null email addresses for future writes.

        - Keep historical `created_at` values.

        - Existing dirty rows include duplicate, null, and blank emails. Preserve those users by assigning deterministic migrated
        email values, and document the cleanup.

        - Also create `$WORKSPACE/in/db/preflight_report.md` describing duplicate/null email issues before migration.

        - The preflight report must also mention dependent orders for dirty users `u4`, `u5`, and `u6`.

        - Also create `$WORKSPACE/in/db/rollback.sql` that can restore the pre-migration schema shape with id, email, name,
        created_at.

        - The rollback script must be executable after the migration and must restore the old schema shape.

        - Also create `$WORKSPACE/in/db/postcheck.sql` with verification queries that can be executed after the migration.
        It must check row counts, dependent order preservation, cleaned dirty-user emails, and email/status constraints.

        - Also create `$WORKSPACE/in/db/migration_report.md` summarizing the migration strategy, dirty-data cleanup, idempotency
        approach, rollback limitation/behavior, and the postcheck queries to run.

        - The migration should run inside an explicit transaction and should be idempotent: running it a second time must
        not corrupt or duplicate user data.

        - Use deterministic cleanup values exactly: duplicate `u4` becomes `ada+u4@example.com`; null email `u5` becomes `missing+u5@example.invalid`;
        blank email `u6` becomes `missing+u6@example.invalid`.


        The migration must run offline in SQLite. Do not use external tools or services.

        '
      hindi: '`$WORKSPACE/in/db/migration.sql` में SQLite migration draft unsafe है। Account status और email constraints जोड़ते
        समय यह data खो देता है।


        Edit से पहले `migration_policy.md` पढ़ें; यह dirty-data cleanup, dependent order preservation, transaction, idempotency
        और rollback expectations बताती है।


        आपका काम:

        - केवल `$WORKSPACE/in/db/migration.sql` edit करें।

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/db/schema.sql` या `$WORKSPACE/in/db/migration_policy.md` edit न करें।

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/db/schema.sql` के सभी existing users रखें।

        - सभी existing orders और उनके `user_id` references रखें।

        - default `active` वाला non-null `status` column जोड़ें।

        - future writes के लिए unique, non-null email addresses लागू करें।

        - historical `created_at` values रखें।

        - Existing dirty rows में duplicate, null और blank emails हैं। Users को deterministic migrated email देकर preserve
        करें और cleanup document करें।

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/db/preflight_report.md` बनाएं, जिसमें migration से पहले duplicate/null email issues हों।

        - Preflight report में dirty users `u4`, `u5`, `u6` के dependent orders भी बताएं।

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/db/rollback.sql` बनाएं जो pre-migration schema shape (`id`, `email`, `name`, `created_at`) restore
        कर सके।

        - Rollback script migration के बाद executable हो और पुराना schema shape restore करे।

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/db/postcheck.sql` बनाएं, जिसमें row counts, dependent order preservation, cleaned dirty-user emails
        और email/status constraints की verification queries हों।

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/db/migration_report.md` में strategy, dirty-data cleanup, idempotency, rollback limitation/behavior
        और postcheck queries summarize करें।

        - Migration explicit transaction में चले और idempotent हो: दूसरी बार चलाने पर data corrupt या duplicate न हो।

        - Cleanup values बिल्कुल ऐसे रखें: duplicate `u4` → `ada+u4@example.com`; null `u5` → `missing+u5@example.invalid`;
        blank `u6` → `missing+u6@example.invalid`।


        Migration offline SQLite में चले; external tools/services न लें।'
      hinglish: '`$WORKSPACE/in/db/migration.sql` ka SQLite migration draft unsafe hai. Account status aur email constraints
        add karte hue data lose ho raha hai.


        Edit se pehle `migration_policy.md` padho; ismein dirty-data cleanup, dependent order preservation, transaction, idempotency
        aur rollback expectations hain.


        Aapka kaam:

        - Sirf `$WORKSPACE/in/db/migration.sql` edit karo.

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/db/schema.sql` ya `$WORKSPACE/in/db/migration_policy.md` edit mat karo.

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/db/schema.sql` ke saare existing users preserve karo.

        - Saare existing orders aur unke `user_id` references preserve karo.

        - Default `active` wala non-null `status` column add karo.

        - Future writes ke liye unique, non-null email addresses enforce karo.

        - Historical `created_at` values retain karo.

        - Dirty rows mein duplicate, null aur blank emails hain. Users ko deterministic migrated email values dekar preserve
        karo aur cleanup document karo.

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/db/preflight_report.md` banao, jisme migration se pehle duplicate/null email issues hon.

        - Preflight report mein dirty users `u4`, `u5`, `u6` ke dependent orders bhi mention karo.

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/db/rollback.sql` banao jo pre-migration shape (`id`, `email`, `name`, `created_at`) restore kar sake.

        - Rollback script migration ke baad executable ho aur old schema shape restore kare.

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/db/postcheck.sql` mein row counts, dependent order preservation, cleaned dirty-user emails aur email/status
        constraints ki verification queries likho.

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/db/migration_report.md` mein strategy, dirty-data cleanup, idempotency, rollback limitation/behavior
        aur postcheck queries summarize karo.

        - Migration explicit transaction ke andar chale aur idempotent ho: second run data corrupt ya duplicate na kare.

        - Cleanup values exact rakho: duplicate `u4` → `ada+u4@example.com`; null `u5` → `missing+u5@example.invalid`; blank
        `u6` → `missing+u6@example.invalid`.


        Migration offline SQLite mein chalni chahiye. External tools/services mat use karo.'
    review:
      english:
        status: canonical
        reviewer: null
      hindi:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
      hinglish:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
  087-cli-parser-bug-tests:
    source_sha256: c4d6abe697dcf8c8125eb0432ddfbb581931e72b79afba9b39e1d709d6ca8f79
    instructions:
      english: 'The CSV filtering CLI in `$WORKSPACE/in/csvtool` has parsing bugs around quoted fields, empty results, and
        descending sort.


        Your job:

        - Run `python -m pytest tests` from `$WORKSPACE/in/csvtool`.

        - Fix the CLI implementation.

        - Add focused regression tests for the bug. A good place is `$WORKSPACE/in/csvtool/tests/test_cli_regression.py`.

        - Verify the full test suite passes.


        Required CLI behavior:

        - `python -m csvtool.cli samples/orders.csv --where status=paid --select id,total --sort -created_at`

        - Repeating `--where` applies all predicates with AND semantics, for example `--where status=paid --where total=750`.

        - CSV parsing and writing must preserve quoted commas correctly.

        - Empty result sets should still print the selected header and exit 0.

        - `--sort -field` means descending; `--sort field` means ascending. Numeric-looking values should sort numerically.

        - Bad `--where` expressions should exit non-zero with a clear message.

        - Selecting, sorting, or filtering on a missing field should exit non-zero with a clear message.


        Constraints:

        - Do not modify existing tests in `tests/test_cli_existing.py`.

        - Do not hard-code sample rows or fixture file paths.

        - Do not introduce pandas, click, or other external dependencies.

        - Do not parse CSV by splitting lines on commas.

        - Do not remove CLI options or bypass filtering.

        '
      hindi: '`$WORKSPACE/in/csvtool` का CSV filtering CLI quoted fields, empty results और descending sort के आसपास parsing
        bugs रखता है।


        आपका काम:

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/csvtool` से `python -m pytest tests` चलाएँ।

        - CLI implementation ठीक करें।

        - Bug के लिए focused regression tests जोड़ें; अच्छा स्थान `$WORKSPACE/in/csvtool/tests/test_cli_regression.py` है।

        - पूरा test suite पास होने की पुष्टि करें।


        आवश्यक CLI behavior:

        - `python -m csvtool.cli samples/orders.csv --where status=paid --select id,total --sort -created_at`

        - एक से अधिक `--where` देने पर सभी predicates AND semantics में लगें, जैसे `--where status=paid --where total=750`।

        - CSV parsing और writing quoted commas को सही तरह preserve करें।

        - Empty result set में भी selected header print हो और exit 0 हो।

        - `--sort -field` descending और `--sort field` ascending हो। Numeric-looking values numeric तरीके से sort हों।

        - गलत `--where` expression clear message के साथ non-zero exit करे।

        - Missing field पर selecting, sorting या filtering clear message के साथ non-zero exit करे।


        Constraints:

        - `tests/test_cli_existing.py` में existing tests modify न करें।

        - Sample rows या fixture paths hard-code न करें।

        - pandas, click या अन्य external dependencies न जोड़ें।

        - CSV को lines पर comma से split न करें।

        - CLI options हटाएँ या filtering bypass न करें।'
      hinglish: '`$WORKSPACE/in/csvtool` ka CSV filtering CLI quoted fields, empty results aur descending sort ke parsing
        bugs rakhta hai.


        Aapka kaam:

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/csvtool` se `python -m pytest tests` run karo.

        - CLI implementation fix karo.

        - Bug ke liye focused regression tests add karo; `$WORKSPACE/in/csvtool/tests/test_cli_regression.py` achhi jagah
        hai.

        - Full test suite pass verify karo.


        Required CLI behavior:

        - `python -m csvtool.cli samples/orders.csv --where status=paid --select id,total --sort -created_at`

        - Repeated `--where` sab predicates ko AND semantics mein apply kare, jaise `--where status=paid --where total=750`.

        - CSV parsing aur writing quoted commas ko correctly preserve kare.

        - Empty result set mein bhi selected header print ho aur exit 0 ho.

        - `--sort -field` descending aur `--sort field` ascending ho; numeric-looking values numerically sort hon.

        - Bad `--where` expression clear message ke saath non-zero exit kare.

        - Missing field par select, sort ya filter karna clear message ke saath non-zero exit kare.


        Constraints:

        - `tests/test_cli_existing.py` ke existing tests modify mat karo.

        - Sample rows ya fixture file paths hard-code mat karo.

        - pandas, click ya koi external dependency add mat karo.

        - CSV ko comma se line-split karke parse mat karo.

        - CLI options remove ya filtering bypass mat karo.'
    review:
      english:
        status: canonical
        reviewer: null
      hindi:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
      hinglish:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
  049-excel-like-cleaning:
    source_sha256: 19c40f5ecc0eacea4a072bc4d252fc89d02d8f57a77c1fa9a98100a13ee074fd
    instructions:
      english: "You are cleaning a messy sales export for a finance reconciliation review. Use only local files.\n\nInputs\
        \ copied to the workspace root:\n- $WORKSPACE/in/messy_sales.csv\n- $WORKSPACE/in/customer_dictionary.csv\n- $WORKSPACE/in/fx_rates.csv\n\
        \nCreate exactly these outputs:\n- $WORKSPACE/out/cleaned_sales.csv\n- $WORKSPACE/out/reject_ledger.csv\n- $WORKSPACE/out/reject_summary.json\n\
        - $WORKSPACE/out/cleaning_report.md\n\nCleaning rules:\n1. Do not modify input files.\n2. Validate customer_id against\
        \ customer_dictionary.csv. Reject rows whose customer_id is unknown or inactive.\n3. Parse order_date using the row\
        \ locale:\n   - en_US dates are month/day/year.\n   - en_GB and de_DE dates are day/month/year.\n   - ISO dates are\
        \ already year-month-day.\n   - Dates with month names such as \"10-Jan-2025\" are valid.\n4. Normalize status to\
        \ lowercase. Refund/returned rows must keep a negative amount_usd.\n5. Normalize amount to USD using fx_rates.csv.\
        \ The amount field is already the row total, not a unit price. Strip currency symbols and accounting parentheses.\
        \ For en_US/en_GB, comma is the thousands separator and dot is the decimal separator. For de_DE, dot is the thousands\
        \ separator and comma is the decimal separator. Round amount_usd to exactly two decimals.\n6. Quantity must be a positive\
        \ integer.\n7. Deduplicate by order_id after validation. Keep the first valid occurrence in input order and reject\
        \ later valid duplicates with reason duplicate_order_id. Invalid rows are rejected for their validation reason rather\
        \ than duplicate_order_id.\n8. Reject rows with invalid dates, unsupported currency, missing/non-numeric amounts,\
        \ invalid quantities, unknown/inactive customers, or duplicates.\n9. If a row has multiple reject reasons, record\
        \ the first applicable reason in this priority order:\n   missing_amount, unsupported_currency, invalid_quantity,\
        \ inactive_customer, unknown_customer, invalid_date, duplicate_order_id.\n10. Refund/returned rows must produce a\
        \ negative amount_usd exactly once: a positive returned amount becomes negative, and an already-negative returned\
        \ amount stays negative.\n\ncleaned_sales.csv requirements:\n- Exact header:\n  order_id,order_date,customer_id,customer_name,sku,quantity,amount_usd,status\n\
        - Rows must be sorted by order_date then order_id.\n- Do not include extra columns.\n\nreject_ledger.csv requirements:\n\
        - Exact header:\n  order_id,reason,source_row,notes\n- Include one row per rejected input row. source_row is 1-based\
        \ data-row number from messy_sales.csv, excluding the header.\n- Use one of the reason codes listed in rule 9.\n\n\
        reject_summary.json requirements:\n- Valid JSON object keyed by every reason code in rule 9, including zero-count\
        \ reasons if any.\n- Each reason entry must contain count, source_rows, and order_ids.\n- source_rows must be numeric\
        \ arrays in ascending input order.\n\ncleaning_report.md requirements:\n- Summarize valid row count, rejected row\
        \ count, duplicate count, and total amount_usd.\n- Explain each reject reason category.\n- Mention any locale or FX\
        \ assumptions used.\n\nDo not use network access or external APIs.\n"
      hindi: 'आप finance reconciliation review के लिए messy sales export साफ कर रहे हैं। केवल local files उपयोग करें।


        Workspace root में copy किए गए inputs:

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/messy_sales.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/customer_dictionary.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/fx_rates.csv`


        ठीक ये outputs बनाएँ:

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/cleaned_sales.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/reject_ledger.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/reject_summary.json`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/cleaning_report.md`


        Cleaning rules:

        1. Input files modify न करें।

        2. `customer_dictionary.csv` से customer_id validate करें। Unknown या inactive customer वाली rows reject करें।

        3. Row locale से order_date parse करें: `en_US` month/day/year है; `en_GB` और `de_DE` day/month/year हैं; ISO dates
        year-month-day हैं; `10-Jan-2025` जैसे month-name dates valid हैं।

        4. status को lowercase करें। Refund/returned rows में negative amount_usd रखना है।

        5. `fx_rates.csv` से amount को USD में normalize करें। amount row total है, unit price नहीं। Currency symbols और accounting
        parentheses हटाएँ। `en_US`/`en_GB` में comma thousands separator और dot decimal separator है; `de_DE` में dot thousands
        और comma decimal separator है। amount_usd को ठीक two decimals तक round करें।

        6. Quantity positive integer हो।

        7. Validation के बाद order_id से deduplicate करें। Input order में पहली valid occurrence रखें और बाद की valid duplicates
        को `duplicate_order_id` reason से reject करें। Invalid rows को `duplicate_order_id` के बजाय उनका validation reason
        दें।

        8. Invalid dates, unsupported currency, missing/non-numeric amounts, invalid quantities, unknown/inactive customers
        या duplicates reject करें।

        9. Multiple reject reasons हों तो पहला reason इस priority में लें: `missing_amount`, `unsupported_currency`, `invalid_quantity`,
        `inactive_customer`, `unknown_customer`, `invalid_date`, `duplicate_order_id`।

        10. Refund/returned rows का amount_usd ठीक एक बार negative हो: positive returned amount negative बने और already-negative
        returned amount वैसा ही रहे।


        `cleaned_sales.csv` requirements:

        - Exact header: `order_id,order_date,customer_id,customer_name,sku,quantity,amount_usd,status`

        - Rows `order_date` फिर `order_id` से sorted हों।

        - Extra columns न हों।


        `reject_ledger.csv` requirements:

        - Exact header: `order_id,reason,source_row,notes`

        - हर rejected input row की एक row हो। source_row `messy_sales.csv` की header छोड़कर 1-based data-row number है।

        - Rule 9 में दिए reason codes में से एक उपयोग करें।


        `reject_summary.json` requirements:

        - Valid JSON object हो, जिसमें rule 9 का हर reason code हो, zero-count reasons भी।

        - हर reason entry में count, source_rows और order_ids हों।

        - source_rows ascending numeric arrays हों।


        `cleaning_report.md` में valid/rejected row count, duplicate count, total amount_usd, हर reject category और locale/FX
        assumptions बताएं।


        Network या external APIs न लें।'
      hinglish: 'Aap finance reconciliation review ke liye messy sales export clean kar rahe ho. Sirf local files use karo.


        Workspace root mein copied inputs:

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/messy_sales.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/customer_dictionary.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/fx_rates.csv`


        Exactly ye outputs banao:

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/cleaned_sales.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/reject_ledger.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/reject_summary.json`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/cleaning_report.md`


        Cleaning rules:

        1. Input files modify mat karo.

        2. `customer_dictionary.csv` se customer_id validate karo; unknown ya inactive customer rows reject karo.

        3. Row locale ke hisaab se order_date parse karo: `en_US` month/day/year, `en_GB` aur `de_DE` day/month/year, ISO
        year-month-day; `10-Jan-2025` jaise month-name dates valid hain.

        4. status lowercase karo. Refund/returned rows mein negative amount_usd rakho.

        5. `fx_rates.csv` use karke amount ko USD mein normalize karo. amount row total hai, unit price nahi. Currency symbols
        aur accounting parentheses strip karo. `en_US`/`en_GB` mein comma thousands aur dot decimal separator; `de_DE` mein
        dot thousands aur comma decimal separator hai. amount_usd ko exactly two decimals round karo.

        6. Quantity positive integer honi chahiye.

        7. Validation ke baad order_id par deduplicate karo. Input order ki first valid occurrence rakho; baad ki valid duplicates
        ko `duplicate_order_id` reason se reject karo. Invalid rows ko duplicate reason ke badle unka validation reason do.

        8. Invalid dates, unsupported currency, missing/non-numeric amounts, invalid quantities, unknown/inactive customers
        ya duplicates reject karo.

        9. Multiple reject reasons hon to priority ke mutabik pehla lo: `missing_amount`, `unsupported_currency`, `invalid_quantity`,
        `inactive_customer`, `unknown_customer`, `invalid_date`, `duplicate_order_id`.

        10. Refund/returned rows mein amount_usd exactly once negative ho: positive returned amount negative bano aur already-negative
        returned amount same rahe.


        `cleaned_sales.csv` requirements:

        - Exact header: `order_id,order_date,customer_id,customer_name,sku,quantity,amount_usd,status`

        - Rows ko `order_date` phir `order_id` se sort karo.

        - Extra columns mat add karo.


        `reject_ledger.csv` requirements:

        - Exact header: `order_id,reason,source_row,notes`

        - Har rejected input row ki ek row ho; source_row `messy_sales.csv` ke header ko chhodkar 1-based data-row number
        hai.

        - Rule 9 ke reason codes mein se ek use karo.


        `reject_summary.json` valid JSON object ho jisme Rule 9 ka har reason code ho, zero-count bhi. Har entry mein count,
        source_rows, order_ids hon; source_rows ascending numeric arrays hon.


        `cleaning_report.md` mein valid/rejected counts, duplicate count, total amount_usd, har reject category aur locale/FX
        assumptions summarize karo.


        Network ya external APIs use mat karo.'
    review:
      english:
        status: canonical
        reviewer: null
      hindi:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
      hinglish:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
  050-multitable-join-analysis:
    source_sha256: cc10eab9c721883f5ee76794d18007996617a16d12a3f38ccbf7ed05a636dabf
    instructions:
      english: "Build customer-level revenue metrics and a reconciliation note from local tables.\n\nInputs copied to the\
        \ workspace root:\n- $WORKSPACE/in/customers.csv\n- $WORKSPACE/in/orders.csv\n- $WORKSPACE/in/payments.csv\n- $WORKSPACE/in/refunds.csv\n\
        - $WORKSPACE/in/fx_rates.csv\n- $WORKSPACE/in/chargebacks.csv\n\nCreate:\n- $WORKSPACE/out/customer_metrics.csv\n\
        - $WORKSPACE/out/region_summary.json\n- $WORKSPACE/out/reconciliation_audit.json\n- $WORKSPACE/out/reconciliation_notes.md\n\
        \ncustomer_metrics.csv columns, in this exact order:\ncanonical_customer_id,name,region,order_count,gross_revenue_usd,refund_amount_usd,chargeback_amount_usd,net_revenue_usd,segment\n\
        Rows must be sorted by canonical_customer_id ascending.\n\nBusiness rules:\n1. Do not modify input files.\n2. Roll\
        \ up aliases using customers.csv canonical_customer_id. Output one row per canonical customer, including canonical\
        \ customers with no valid revenue.\n3. `order_count` counts distinct `order_id` values whose `order_status` is paid\
        \ and that have at least one captured payment. Multiple captured payment rows for the same order still count as one\
        \ order.\n4. Gross revenue comes from captured payments, not from order_amount. Ignore duplicate payment rows only\
        \ when `(order_id, amount, currency, status)` all match; captured payments for the same order with different amounts\
        \ are additive.\n5. Convert payments, refunds, and chargebacks to USD using fx_rates.csv.\n6. Captured payments that\
        \ reference a missing order_id are orphan payments. Do not count them as revenue, but list them in reconciliation_notes.md.\n\
        7. Refunds count only when they reference an order that is both paid and included through captured payment revenue.\
        \ Orphan refunds, refunds for cancelled orders, and refunds for orders without captured revenue are anomalies, not\
        \ revenue deductions.\n8. Chargebacks count only when they reference an included paid/captured order and status is\
        \ won_by_customer. won_by_merchant chargebacks are reconciliation notes but not revenue deductions.\n9. Net revenue\
        \ = gross revenue - refunds - chargebacks.\n10. Format money fields with exactly two decimals.\n11. Segment canonical\
        \ customers as:\n   - platinum when net_revenue_usd >= 500\n   - gold when net_revenue_usd >= 250 and < 500\n   -\
        \ silver when net_revenue_usd > 0 and < 250\n   - dormant when net_revenue_usd == 0\n\nregion_summary.json requirements:\n\
        - Valid JSON object keyed by region.\n- Each region entry must include canonical_customer_count, gross_revenue_usd,\
        \ net_revenue_usd.\n\nreconciliation_notes.md requirements:\n- Explain the revenue basis.\n- List duplicate payments,\
        \ orphan payments, orphan refunds, refunds against cancelled/no-captured orders, and chargebacks.\n- Mention the canonical\
        \ customer merge.\n\nreconciliation_audit.json requirements:\n- Valid JSON with keys: duplicate_payment_ids, orphan_payment_ids,\
        \ refund_anomaly_ids, included_chargeback_ids, excluded_chargeback_ids, alias_customer_ids.\n- Each value must be\
        \ an array of IDs sorted ascending.\n- duplicate_payment_ids are duplicate captured payment rows ignored by the tuple\
        \ rule.\n- refund_anomaly_ids include orphan refunds, refunds for cancelled orders, and refunds for orders without\
        \ captured revenue.\n- excluded_chargeback_ids include chargebacks that are not deducted because the order is not\
        \ included or the chargeback status is not won_by_customer.\n\nDo not use network access. Do not add extra columns\
        \ to customer_metrics.csv.\n"
      hindi: 'Local tables से customer-level revenue metrics और reconciliation note बनाएं।


        Inputs:

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/customers.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/orders.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/payments.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/refunds.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/fx_rates.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/chargebacks.csv`


        बनाएँ:

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/customer_metrics.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/region_summary.json`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/reconciliation_audit.json`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/reconciliation_notes.md`


        `customer_metrics.csv` में columns इसी exact order में हों: `canonical_customer_id,name,region,order_count,gross_revenue_usd,refund_amount_usd,chargeback_amount_usd,net_revenue_usd,segment`।
        Rows `canonical_customer_id` ascending हों।


        Business rules:

        1. Input files modify न करें।

        2. `customers.csv` के canonical_customer_id से aliases roll up करें। हर canonical customer की एक row दें, valid revenue
        न होने पर भी।

        3. `order_count` distinct `order_id` गिने: `order_status` paid हो और कम-से-कम एक captured payment हो। एक order की
        multiple captured payment rows फिर भी एक order हैं।

        4. Gross revenue captured payments से आए, `order_amount` से नहीं। Duplicate payment rows तभी ignore करें जब `(order_id,
        amount, currency, status)` सभी match करें; अलग amount वाली captured payments additive हैं।

        5. Payments, refunds और chargebacks को `fx_rates.csv` से USD में बदलें।

        6. Missing order_id वाले captured payments orphan payments हैं। Revenue में न गिनें, लेकिन `reconciliation_notes.md`
        में list करें।

        7. Refund तभी count करें जब वह paid order को reference करे और captured payment revenue में included हो। Orphan refunds,
        cancelled orders के refunds और बिना captured revenue वाले refunds anomalies हैं, revenue deduction नहीं।

        8. Chargeback तभी count करें जब included paid/captured order को reference करे और status `won_by_customer` हो। `won_by_merchant`
        chargebacks notes में आएँ, revenue deduction नहीं।

        9. Net revenue = gross revenue - refunds - chargebacks।

        10. Money fields ठीक two decimals में format हों।

        11. Segment: platinum जब net_revenue_usd >= 500; gold जब >= 250 और < 500; silver जब > 0 और < 250; dormant जब == 0।


        `region_summary.json` region-keyed valid JSON हो; हर region में canonical_customer_count, gross_revenue_usd, net_revenue_usd
        हों।


        `reconciliation_notes.md` revenue basis, duplicate/orphan payments, orphan refunds, cancelled/no-captured refunds,
        chargebacks और canonical customer merge समझाए।


        `reconciliation_audit.json` में keys `duplicate_payment_ids`, `orphan_payment_ids`, `refund_anomaly_ids`, `included_chargeback_ids`,
        `excluded_chargeback_ids`, `alias_customer_ids` हों। हर value ascending sorted IDs की array हो।


        Network न लें और `customer_metrics.csv` में extra columns न जोड़ें।'
      hinglish: 'Local tables se customer-level revenue metrics aur reconciliation note banao.


        Inputs:

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/customers.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/orders.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/payments.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/refunds.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/fx_rates.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/chargebacks.csv`


        Create:

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/customer_metrics.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/region_summary.json`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/reconciliation_audit.json`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/reconciliation_notes.md`


        `customer_metrics.csv` columns exact order mein hon: `canonical_customer_id,name,region,order_count,gross_revenue_usd,refund_amount_usd,chargeback_amount_usd,net_revenue_usd,segment`.
        Rows `canonical_customer_id` ascending sort hon.


        Business rules:

        1. Input files modify mat karo.

        2. `customers.csv` ke canonical_customer_id se aliases roll up karo; har canonical customer ki row do, chahe valid
        revenue na ho.

        3. `order_count` distinct `order_id` count kare jab `order_status` paid ho aur kam-se-kam ek captured payment ho.
        Same order ki multiple captured payment rows phir bhi ek order count hon.

        4. Gross revenue captured payments se lo, `order_amount` se nahi. Duplicate payment rows sirf tab ignore karo jab
        `(order_id, amount, currency, status)` sab match karein; different amounts wali captured payments additive hain.

        5. Payments, refunds aur chargebacks ko `fx_rates.csv` se USD mein convert karo.

        6. Missing order_id wale captured payments orphan payments hain: revenue mein count mat karo, par `reconciliation_notes.md`
        mein list karo.

        7. Refund tab count karo jab paid order reference ho aur captured payment revenue mein included ho. Orphan refunds,
        cancelled orders ke refunds aur no-captured-revenue refunds anomalies hain, deductions nahi.

        8. Chargeback tab count karo jab included paid/captured order reference ho aur status `won_by_customer` ho. `won_by_merchant`
        notes mein aaye, deduction nahi.

        9. Net revenue = gross revenue - refunds - chargebacks.

        10. Money fields exactly two decimals format karo.

        11. Segment rules: net_revenue_usd >= 500 par platinum; >= 250 aur < 500 par gold; > 0 aur < 250 par silver; == 0
        par dormant.


        `region_summary.json` region-keyed valid JSON ho; har entry mein canonical_customer_count, gross_revenue_usd, net_revenue_usd
        hon.


        `reconciliation_notes.md` revenue basis, duplicate/orphan payments, orphan refunds, cancelled/no-captured refunds,
        chargebacks aur canonical customer merge explain kare.


        `reconciliation_audit.json` keys `duplicate_payment_ids`, `orphan_payment_ids`, `refund_anomaly_ids`, `included_chargeback_ids`,
        `excluded_chargeback_ids`, `alias_customer_ids` rakhe. Har value ascending sorted IDs ki array ho.


        Network use mat karo aur `customer_metrics.csv` mein extra columns mat add karo.'
    review:
      english:
        status: canonical
        reviewer: null
      hindi:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
      hinglish:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
  051-sql-query-report:
    source_sha256: 2a352aace07462f99a51d5690fab7bc222d394bf5907f4cbb3f10be93b5f80c1
    instructions:
      english: "Use the offline SQL fixture to produce a small BI report.\n\nInput:\n- $WORKSPACE/in/schema_data.sql\n\nCreate:\n\
        - $WORKSPACE/out/query_results.json\n- $WORKSPACE/out/analysis.md\n- $WORKSPACE/out/query_audit.json\n\nRequirements:\n\
        1. Load schema_data.sql into a local SQLite database or otherwise execute equivalent SQL locally.\n2. Consider only\
        \ orders where status = 'paid' and order_date is from 2025-01-01 through 2025-03-31 inclusive.\n3. query_results.json\
        \ must be valid JSON with exactly these top-level keys:\n   - top_products_by_revenue\n   - revenue_by_region\n  \
        \ - category_summary\n4. top_products_by_revenue must contain the top 3 products by revenue, descending, with fields:\n\
        \   product_id, product_name, revenue\n   Break revenue ties by product_id ascending.\n5. revenue_by_region must contain\
        \ one row per customer region with fields:\n   region, order_count, revenue\n   Sort region rows by region ascending.\n\
        6. category_summary must contain one row per product category with fields:\n   category, units_sold, revenue\n   Sort\
        \ category rows by category ascending.\n7. Revenue values must be numbers or numeric strings rounded to two decimal\
        \ places.\n8. analysis.md must briefly identify the top product, highest revenue region, tie handling if any, and\
        \ excluded records rule.\n9. The date window includes 2025-01-01 and 2025-03-31. Exclude returned, cancelled, and\
        \ out-of-window orders even if they have large order_items.\n\nquery_audit.json requirements:\n- Valid JSON with keys:\
        \ included_order_ids, excluded_status_order_ids, excluded_out_of_window_order_ids, boundary_included_order_ids, top_product_tie_order.\n\
        - The first four keys must be arrays of order_id strings sorted ascending.\n- top_product_tie_order must list the\
        \ product_ids that are tied by revenue in the exact output order used for top_products_by_revenue.\n\nDo not modify\
        \ fixtures. Do not use network access or external APIs.\n"
      hindi: 'Offline SQL fixture से एक छोटा BI report बनाएं।


        Input: `$WORKSPACE/in/schema_data.sql`


        बनाएँ:

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/query_results.json`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/analysis.md`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/query_audit.json`


        आवश्यकताएँ:

        1. `schema_data.sql` को local SQLite database में load करें या equivalent SQL locally execute करें।

        2. केवल वे orders लें जिनका status `paid` है और order_date 2025-01-01 से 2025-03-31 inclusive है।

        3. `query_results.json` valid JSON हो और top-level पर ठीक ये keys हों: `top_products_by_revenue`, `revenue_by_region`,
        `category_summary`।

        4. `top_products_by_revenue` revenue के अनुसार descending top 3 products रखे; fields `product_id`, `product_name`,
        `revenue` हों। Tie होने पर `product_id` ascending से break करें।

        5. `revenue_by_region` में हर customer region की एक row हो; fields `region`, `order_count`, `revenue` हों; region
        ascending sort हो।

        6. `category_summary` में हर product category की एक row हो; fields `category`, `units_sold`, `revenue` हों; category
        ascending sort हो।

        7. Revenue values numbers या दो decimal places वाले numeric strings हों।

        8. `analysis.md` में top product, highest revenue region, tie handling और excluded-record rule briefly बताएं।

        9. Date window में 2025-01-01 और 2025-03-31 शामिल हैं। Returned, cancelled और out-of-window orders को exclude करें,
        भले उनके order_items बड़े हों।


        `query_audit.json` keys रखे: `included_order_ids`, `excluded_status_order_ids`, `excluded_out_of_window_order_ids`,
        `boundary_included_order_ids`, `top_product_tie_order`। पहले चार keys ascending sorted order_id strings की arrays
        हों। `top_product_tie_order` में top_products_by_revenue के exact output order में tied product_ids हों।


        Fixtures modify न करें और network/external APIs न लें।'
      hinglish: 'Offline SQL fixture se ek chhota BI report banao.


        Input: `$WORKSPACE/in/schema_data.sql`


        Create:

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/query_results.json`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/analysis.md`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/query_audit.json`


        Requirements:

        1. `schema_data.sql` ko local SQLite database mein load karo ya equivalent SQL locally execute karo.

        2. Sirf status `paid` wale orders lo jinka order_date 2025-01-01 se 2025-03-31 inclusive ho.

        3. `query_results.json` valid JSON ho aur exact top-level keys `top_products_by_revenue`, `revenue_by_region`, `category_summary`
        hon.

        4. `top_products_by_revenue` mein revenue descending top 3 products hon, fields `product_id`, `product_name`, `revenue`;
        tie ko `product_id` ascending se break karo.

        5. `revenue_by_region` mein har customer region ki row ho, fields `region`, `order_count`, `revenue`; rows region
        ascending sort hon.

        6. `category_summary` mein har product category ki row ho, fields `category`, `units_sold`, `revenue`; rows category
        ascending sort hon.

        7. Revenue values numbers ya exactly two-decimal numeric strings ho.

        8. `analysis.md` mein top product, highest revenue region, tie handling aur excluded-record rule briefly identify
        karo.

        9. Date window 2025-01-01 aur 2025-03-31 ko include karta hai. Returned, cancelled aur out-of-window orders exclude
        karo, chahe unke order_items bade hon.


        `query_audit.json` mein keys `included_order_ids`, `excluded_status_order_ids`, `excluded_out_of_window_order_ids`,
        `boundary_included_order_ids`, `top_product_tie_order` hon. Pehle four keys ascending order_id strings arrays hon.
        `top_product_tie_order` mein output ke exact order mein tied product_ids hon.


        Fixtures modify mat karo; network ya external APIs use mat karo.'
    review:
      english:
        status: canonical
        reviewer: null
      hindi:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
      hinglish:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
  053-anomalous-transaction-detect:
    source_sha256: eb691bd9daf5f49ea3f4e986c94a0617ecc53d676e55dbd68cb471b830a326df
    instructions:
      english: 'Detect suspicious transactions using the local rulebook.


        Inputs:

        - $WORKSPACE/in/transactions.csv

        - $WORKSPACE/in/rules.md


        Create:

        - $WORKSPACE/out/suspicious_transactions.csv

        - $WORKSPACE/out/rule_audit.json

        - $WORKSPACE/out/case_notes.md


        suspicious_transactions.csv columns, in this exact order:

        transaction_id,customer_id,rule_id,risk_level,reason


        Rules:

        1. Do not modify fixtures.

        2. Apply only the rules in rules.md.

        3. Include every transaction that triggers at least one rule.

        4. If a transaction triggers multiple rules, use the highest-risk rule and mention other triggered rule ids in reason.

        5. Do not include transactions that do not trigger any rule.

        6. For card velocity, evaluate transactions by timestamp, not CSV row order.

        7. case_notes.md must summarize the number of suspicious transactions and mention each triggered rule_id.


        rule_audit.json requirements:

        - Valid JSON with keys: suspicious_transaction_ids, non_suspicious_transaction_ids, rule_counts, secondary_rule_ids.

        - suspicious_transaction_ids and non_suspicious_transaction_ids must be sorted arrays.

        - rule_counts maps each rule_id to the number of suspicious transactions whose primary rule_id is that rule.

        - secondary_rule_ids maps only multi-rule transaction_ids to sorted arrays of the other triggered rule ids mentioned
        in the CSV reason.


        Do not use network access or external APIs.

        '
      hindi: 'Local rulebook का उपयोग करके suspicious transactions detect करें।


        Inputs:

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/transactions.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/rules.md`


        बनाएँ:

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/suspicious_transactions.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/rule_audit.json`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/case_notes.md`


        `suspicious_transactions.csv` columns इसी exact order में हों: `transaction_id,customer_id,rule_id,risk_level,reason`।


        Rules:

        1. Fixtures modify न करें।

        2. केवल `rules.md` के rules apply करें।

        3. कम-से-कम एक rule trigger करने वाली हर transaction include करें।

        4. Multiple rules trigger हों तो highest-risk rule चुनें और reason में बाकी triggered rule ids लिखें।

        5. कोई rule trigger न करने वाली transactions include न करें।

        6. Card velocity के लिए CSV row order नहीं, timestamp से transactions evaluate करें।

        7. `case_notes.md` में suspicious transaction count summarize करें और हर triggered rule_id mention करें।


        `rule_audit.json` valid JSON हो और keys `suspicious_transaction_ids`, `non_suspicious_transaction_ids`, `rule_counts`,
        `secondary_rule_ids` हों। पहले दो sorted arrays हों। `rule_counts` हर rule_id को उस rule को primary rule बनाने वाली
        suspicious transactions की संख्या से map करे। `secondary_rule_ids` केवल multi-rule transaction_ids के लिए sorted arrays
        रखे, और वही ids CSV reason में हों।


        Network या external APIs न लें।'
      hinglish: 'Local rulebook use karke suspicious transactions detect karo.


        Inputs:

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/transactions.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/rules.md`


        Create:

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/suspicious_transactions.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/rule_audit.json`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/case_notes.md`


        `suspicious_transactions.csv` columns exact order mein: `transaction_id,customer_id,rule_id,risk_level,reason`.


        Rules:

        1. Fixtures modify mat karo.

        2. Sirf `rules.md` ke rules apply karo.

        3. Har transaction include karo jo kam-se-kam ek rule trigger kare.

        4. Multiple rules hon to highest-risk rule use karo aur reason mein baaki triggered rule ids mention karo.

        5. Koi rule trigger na karne wali transactions include mat karo.

        6. Card velocity ko CSV row order se nahi, timestamp ke basis par evaluate karo.

        7. `case_notes.md` mein suspicious count summarize karo aur har triggered rule_id mention karo.


        `rule_audit.json` valid JSON ho, keys `suspicious_transaction_ids`, `non_suspicious_transaction_ids`, `rule_counts`,
        `secondary_rule_ids`. Pehle do sorted arrays hon. `rule_counts` har rule_id ko primary rule wali suspicious transactions
        ke count se map kare. `secondary_rule_ids` sirf multi-rule transaction_ids ke liye sorted arrays rakhe aur CSV reason
        mein wahi ids hon.


        Network ya external APIs use mat karo.'
    review:
      english:
        status: canonical
        reviewer: null
      hindi:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
      hinglish:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
  054-budget-variance-analysis:
    source_sha256: 81ad8127c188f7d30684dd48baa1b716d4239cf9f79884ea97e38cd966d7d47a
    instructions:
      english: "Prepare a budget-vs-actuals variance report.\n\nInputs:\n- $WORKSPACE/in/budget.csv\n- $WORKSPACE/in/actuals.csv\n\
        \nCreate:\n- $WORKSPACE/out/variance_report.csv\n- $WORKSPACE/out/department_rollup.csv\n- $WORKSPACE/out/review_reasons.json\n\
        - $WORKSPACE/out/summary.md\n\nvariance_report.csv columns, in this exact order:\ndepartment,category,budget_amount,actual_amount,variance_amount,variance_pct,flag\n\
        \nRules:\n1. Do not modify fixtures.\n2. Use a full outer join across budget.csv and actuals.csv by department and\
        \ category.\n   - If a budget row has no matching actual row, set actual_amount to 0.00.\n   - If an actual row has\
        \ no matching budget row, include it as an unplanned item with budget_amount 0.00.\n3. variance_amount = actual_amount\
        \ - budget_amount.\n4. variance_pct = variance_amount / budget_amount * 100.\n   - If budget_amount is 0.00 and actual_amount\
        \ is nonzero, set variance_pct to N/A and flag review.\n   - If both budget_amount and actual_amount are 0.00, set\
        \ variance_pct to 0.00 and flag ok.\n5. Format amount fields with exactly two decimals and variance_pct with exactly\
        \ two decimals.\n6. flag must be review when absolute variance_pct is strictly greater than 10.00, otherwise ok. Exactly\
        \ 10.00 is ok.\n7. summary.md must name every review item and the largest overrun by variance_amount.\n8. summary.md\
        \ must mention any unplanned actuals, zero-budget rows, or missing actuals.\n\ndepartment_rollup.csv requirements:\n\
        - Exact header:\n  department,budget_amount,actual_amount,variance_amount,variance_pct,review_item_count,rollup_flag\n\
        - Sum all variance_report.csv rows by department after the full outer join logic.\n- variance_pct is department variance_amount\
        \ / department budget_amount * 100.\n- If department budget_amount is 0.00 and actual_amount is nonzero, variance_pct\
        \ is N/A.\n- review_item_count is the number of category rows in that department with flag=review.\n- rollup_flag\
        \ is review when review_item_count > 0, otherwise ok.\n- Sort rows by department ascending.\n\nreview_reasons.json\
        \ requirements:\n- Valid JSON object keyed by each review item as `\"Department Category\"`.\n- Each value must contain\
        \ reason_type and primary_driver.\n- reason_type must be one of: overrun_pct, underrun_pct, unplanned_actual, missing_actual,\
        \ zero_budget_actual.\n- primary_driver should briefly identify the rule that caused the review flag, such as `variance_pct\
        \ > 10`, `variance_pct < -10`, `budget missing`, `actual missing`, or `budget is zero with actual spend`.\n\nDo not\
        \ use network access or external APIs.\n"
      hindi: 'Budget और actuals की variance report तैयार करें।


        Inputs:

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/budget.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/actuals.csv`


        बनाएँ:

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/variance_report.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/department_rollup.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/review_reasons.json`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/summary.md`


        `variance_report.csv` columns exact order में: `department,category,budget_amount,actual_amount,variance_amount,variance_pct,flag`।


        Rules:

        1. Input files modify न करें।

        2. department और category पर budget.csv तथा actuals.csv का full outer join करें। Budget row का matching actual न हो
        तो actual_amount 0.00 रखें। Actual row का budget न हो तो budget_amount 0.00 वाला unplanned item include करें।

        3. variance_amount = actual_amount - budget_amount।

        4. variance_pct = variance_amount / budget_amount * 100। यदि budget_amount 0.00 और actual_amount nonzero हो तो variance_pct
        N/A और flag review; यदि दोनों 0.00 हों तो variance_pct 0.00 और flag ok।

        5. Amount fields ठीक two decimals और variance_pct ठीक two decimals में format करें।

        6. Absolute variance_pct strictly 10.00 से बड़ा हो तो flag review, अन्यथा ok। ठीक 10.00 ok है।

        7. `summary.md` में हर review item और variance_amount का largest overrun नाम दें।

        8. Unplanned actuals, zero-budget rows और missing actuals बताएं।


        `department_rollup.csv` exact header: `department,budget_amount,actual_amount,variance_amount,variance_pct,review_item_count,rollup_flag`।
        Full outer join के बाद `variance_report.csv` rows को department से sum करें। variance_pct department variance_amount
        / department budget_amount * 100 हो। Zero budget और nonzero actual पर N/A हो। review_item_count उस department की `flag=review`
        category rows की संख्या हो। review_item_count > 0 पर rollup_flag review, अन्यथा ok। Rows department ascending हों।


        `review_reasons.json` valid JSON object हो, हर review item को `"Department Category"` key से रखे। हर value में reason_type
        और primary_driver हों। reason_type केवल `overrun_pct`, `underrun_pct`, `unplanned_actual`, `missing_actual`, `zero_budget_actual`
        में से हो।


        Network या external APIs न लें।


        Technical terms to preserve exactly: `10`, `actual missing`, `budget is zero with actual spend`, `budget missing`,
        `variance_pct < -10`, `variance_pct > 10`'
      hinglish: 'Budget-vs-actuals variance report taiyar karo.


        Inputs:

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/budget.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/in/actuals.csv`


        Create:

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/variance_report.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/department_rollup.csv`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/review_reasons.json`

        - `$WORKSPACE/out/summary.md`


        `variance_report.csv` exact column order: `department,category,budget_amount,actual_amount,variance_amount,variance_pct,flag`.


        Rules:

        1. Input files modify mat karo.

        2. department aur category par budget.csv aur actuals.csv ka full outer join karo. Matching actual na ho to actual_amount
        0.00; matching budget na ho to budget_amount 0.00 ke saath unplanned item include karo.

        3. variance_amount = actual_amount - budget_amount.

        4. variance_pct = variance_amount / budget_amount * 100. budget_amount 0.00 aur actual nonzero ho to variance_pct
        N/A, flag review; dono 0.00 hon to variance_pct 0.00, flag ok.

        5. Amount fields exactly two decimals aur variance_pct exactly two decimals format karo.

        6. Absolute variance_pct strictly 10.00 se bada ho to review, warna ok. Exactly 10.00 ok hai.

        7. `summary.md` mein har review item aur largest overrun by variance_amount name karo.

        8. Unplanned actuals, zero-budget rows aur missing actuals mention karo.


        `department_rollup.csv` exact header: `department,budget_amount,actual_amount,variance_amount,variance_pct,review_item_count,rollup_flag`.
        Full outer join logic ke baad `variance_report.csv` rows ko department se sum karo. Department variance_pct = department
        variance_amount / department budget_amount * 100. Zero budget aur nonzero actual par N/A. review_item_count `flag=review`
        category rows ka count ho; count > 0 par rollup_flag review, warna ok. Rows department ascending sort karo.


        `review_reasons.json` valid JSON object ho aur har review item ko `"Department Category"` key se represent kare. Har
        value mein reason_type aur primary_driver ho. reason_type sirf `overrun_pct`, `underrun_pct`, `unplanned_actual`,
        `missing_actual`, `zero_budget_actual` ho.


        Network ya external APIs use mat karo.


        Technical terms to preserve exactly: `10`, `actual missing`, `budget is zero with actual spend`, `budget missing`,
        `variance_pct < -10`, `variance_pct > 10`'
    review:
      english:
        status: canonical
        reviewer: null
      hindi:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
      hinglish:
        status: unreviewed
        reviewer: null
  001-file:
    source_sha256: e2b787e9f73ef6708d31b96d06ac98c63c86416ea7429bcddc2c0417f3a2a427
    instructions:
      english: 'The working directory is `$WORKSPACE`.


        Read `in/input.txt`, count the number of lines in the file, and write the result to `out/linecount.txt`.


        Requirements:

        - Write only a single integer (the line count).

        - Do not modify `in/input.txt`.

        '
      hindi: '# फ़ाइल कार्य


        कार्य-निर्देशिका `$WORKSPACE` है।


        `in/input.txt` पढ़ें, फ़ाइल में लाइनों की संख्या गिनें और परिणाम `out/linecount.txt` में लिखें।


        आवश्यकताएँ:

        - केवल एक पूर्णांक लिखें (लाइन की संख्या)।

        - `in/input.txt` में कोई बदलाव न करें।'
      hinglish: '# File task


        Working directory `$WORKSPACE` hai.


        `in/input.txt` padho, file ki lines count karo aur result `out/linecount.txt` mein likho.


        Requirements:

        - Sirf ek integer likhna hai (line count).

        - `in/input.txt` ko modify mat karo.'
    review:

        status: canonical
